The following is to explain how the quest starts via the radio broadcast:   1. The Change Location Event script runs automatically when you enter the Mire, which starts the Fishing_MQ01_ChangeLocation quest.    2. That quest has a script in it called Fishing:MQ01ChangeLocationQuestScript that uses a keyword to start the Fishing_MQ01_Casting quest.    3. That, in turn, uses a fragment in stage 100 to start the Fishing_MQ01_Casting_Radio quest via another keyword.     4. A RadioTransmitMarker at HarpersFerryTunnel is broadcasting signal 103.1 to a distance that covers most of the Mire (160,648 units)    5. Quest Fishing_MQ01_Casting_Radio is constantly checking if the player's radio is on and if they are listening to the right frequency. If so, it plays the radio message scene and progresses to stage 200.    6. Stage 200 contains a fragment that sets stage 150 in Fishing_MQ01_Casting, which tells the player to explore Fisherman's Rest.

What's going on? --------------------- Starting the event!  Wagon: ----------- Here we repair the wagon just in-case.  Objective: ------------- We then start the objective to speak to Gunther, needed to start the next stages of the event.  Goto: -------- Prep Stage started from Gunther Dialogue Scene.
The Wild West Showdown game is going to start soon. Maybe I should speak to the showrunner and join.

What's going on? --------------------- After speaking to Gunther and selecting to start the event, we have this prep timer stage.  Gunther will play his instructions PA VO lines here.  Objective UI -------------------- We end speaking to Gunther, then we have a prepare for the event timer objective start.
I've signed up to play the Wild West Showdown game. I should prepare and go into the town before the game starts.

What's going on? --------------------- We use this quick stage to add a bunch of settings before moving to the wave spawn.  Objective UI ---------------- We end the prep timer, and we start the robbing town objectives.  Scripts: ---------- We turn on the lootable dispensers and safes, so players can use the activators to get the Buckaroos.  We then move to the Wave 1 stage.

What's going on? --------------------- We fire the Gunther PA VO line as we start and spawn the enemies. We also set our timer to move to the next wave stage.  Enemies ---------- We spawn Protectrons and Liberators here.  Scripts: --------- We have a timer set here to move to the next stage. (Wave 2)
The game has begun! I should gather loot from around town by "robbing" the cutouts and safes. Have to beat the score by depositing the loot into that "Getaway Wagon".

What's going on? --------------------- We fire the Gunther PA VO line as the Cappy & Bottle cutouts spawn, and we add more enemy spawns. We also set our timer to move to the next wave stage here too.  Enemies ---------- We spawn more Protectrons, while stopping the slower spans version. We also spawn the Golden Liberator.  The "Gold Varmint" gives you a $100 score boost if killed, but it is very tough, running around ignoring the players.   Cappy & Bottle Cutouts: ------------------------------ Here we spawn one Cappy and Bottle cutout. They each have one of eight locations they could appear around the map.  If picked up, they say a line and Gunther has a VO line to inform everyone that one has been found.  You can deposit them for $100 score each, where they say a VO line and Gunther will inform everyone of this.  Scripts: --------- We have a timer set here to move to the next stage. (Wave 3)

What's going on? --------------------- We fire the Gunther PA VO line where he gives one of two hints, and we add more enemy spawns.   We also have the overall timer fail this stage if players do not meet the score amount.  Enemies ---------- Here we remove slower Liberators and add faster ones. We also add an Assaultron spawn.  Scripts: --------- Timer or Score determins the stage change. (Fail Score or Score Met)

What's going on? -------------------- We are spawning Cappy & Bottle cutouts when we call this stage.  They spawn one each in eight possible locations each in the Wild West Showdown area.  They have a giggle when you are near, and they say a VO line when picked up, also when deposited in the wagon.  They give you $100 to the score when deposited.
What's going on? -------------------- Cappy has been picked up by the player, so we play his VO line.
What's going on? -------------------- Bottle has been picked up by the player, so we play his VO line.
What's going on? -------------------- Cappy has been deposited in the Getaway Wagon by the player, so we play his VO line.
What's going on? -------------------- Bottle has been deposited in the Getaway Wagon by the player, so we play his VO line.
What's going on? -------------------- Cappy and Bottle have both been deposited in the Getaway Wagon at the same time by the player, so we play a VO line.
What's going on? --------------------- Complete objective UI and progress to defence stage.  Scripts: --------- We complete objectives and launch next stage. (Pre-Defence Stage)
What's going on? --------------------- here we stop all the enemies spawning and go to the Start Defence Stage.

What's going on? --------------------- Here we set up the Defend the Getaway Wagon objective and the center screen announcement message for it.   Gunther plays his VO for instructions, and we disable all the safes/dispensers/Cappy&Bottle, and remove all loot from inventory.   Scripts: --------- We then move players to the next stage quickly. (Wave 4)

What's going on? -------------------- We spawn the new enemies that attack the Getaway Wagon, being Protectrons, Liberators and Assaultrons.  Gunther VO line plays for enemies attacking the Getaway Wagon.  Scripts: ---------- We set a timer here to move to the next stage. (Wave 5)
I "robbed" the town. Now I have to defend the "Getaway Wagon" till the time runs out to win.

What's going on? --------------------- We spawn the remaining extra Protectrons and Liberators.  We also trigger the "High Noon" showmanship effects. -Mine doors open -Smoke at mine -Bell chimes -Explosion, then Sheriff spawns -Mine doors close after  Scripts: ---------- If you kill the Sheriff we go to the Win Stage, same if timer get's to 0:00 with the Getaway Wagon not destoryed.  Fail Wagon stage if it is destroyed.

I still have to defend the "Getaway Wagon" till the time runs out to win, but it's now "high noon" and the "Sheriff" is in town. I now have to deal with him attacking the wagon too, but maybe I can win by beating him instead.
What's going on? --------------------- We play a Gunther VO line when the Getaway Wagon HP is at 75%.
What's going on? --------------------- We play a Gunther VO line when the Getaway Wagon HP is at 50%.
What's going on? --------------------- We play a Gunther VO line when the Getaway Wagon HP is at 25%.

What's going on? --------------------- This is where we go when the timer ends. Killing the Sheriff will also trigger this stage.  We fire the VO Gunther PA voice line for the timer ending.  We kill all the enemies and skip to the Win Stage.

What's going on? --------------------- This is the victory stage set by killing the Sheriff, or defending the Getaway Wagon till the timer ends in wave 4-5.  We fire the PA voice line for the victory.  We complete all objectives and skip to the Complete Stage.
I took part in the Wild West Showdown at Nuka-World on Tour. I "robbed" the town, and defended the "Getaway Wagon" from a hoard of "lawmen" robots, and was rewarded with some Nuka goodies.

What's going on? --------------------- This is the fail stage if the Getaway Wagon is destroyed in Wave 4-5.  We fire the VO Gunther PA voice line for the failure.  We kill all enemies, then fail all objectives and skip to the Cleanup stage.
I took part in the Wild West Showdown at Nuka-World on Tour. I tried to "rob" the town and defend the "Getaway Wagon", but was stopped by a hoard of "lawmen" robots.

What's going on? --------------------- This is the fail stage if the score is too low during Wave 3 when the timer ends.  We fire the VO Gunther PA voice line for the failure.  We kill all enemies, then fail all objectives and skip to the Cleanup stage.

I made a backup copy of the Diehards' key. I need to find out what happened to the Gourmands at Bolton Greens and track down their key fragment.

Rose sent me on a wild goose chase while she tried to cheat me out of the loot, but she felt bad about it and left it for me. She could be lying again, but it still seems worth checking out.
